instruction.name: movcf2fr
instruction.description: Move condition code cj into fd.

experiments.name: condition-code dependency chain
experiments.notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1.

latencies.notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movcf2fr $f0, $fcc0; movcf2fr $f1, $fcc1; movcf2fr $f2, $fcc2; movcf2fr $f3, $fcc3; movcf2fr $f4, $fcc4; movcf2fr $f5, $fcc5; movcf2fr $f6, $fcc6; movcf2fr $f7, $fcc7
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r4' --asm 'movcf2fr $f0, $fcc0; movcf2fr $f1, $fcc1; movcf2fr $f2, $fcc2; movcf2fr $f3, $fcc3; movcf2fr $f4, $fcc4; movcf2fr $f5, $fcc5; movcf2fr $f6, $fcc6; movcf2fr $f7, $fcc7'

notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1. Throughput is 1 CPI for movcf2gr/movgr2cf and 0.5 CPI for movcf2fr/movfr2cf.
